title: Break Statement
concept: break immediately exits the innermost loop — use it to stop looping when you've found what you need.
why: Sometimes you don't need to finish the loop. Break lets you exit early when your goal is accomplished.
tips: `break` exits the loop immediately — code after it in the loop body won't run
Use `break` for early exit: 'found it, stop searching'
`break` only exits the innermost loop in nested loops
Combine `break` with `while true` for loops with complex exit conditions
common_mistakes: Thinking `break` exits the entire program — it only exits the loop
Using `break` outside a loop — it only works inside `while` or `for`
Putting code after `break` in the same branch — it's dead code
